meta.title: Desperate Ground
meta.description: The mistakes of the past are now slowly removing all traces of her from this world.

units.rawText: Creak—the door opens. Centaureissi hands me a cup of warm water and some recently opened biscuits.
units.displayText: Creak—the door opens. Centaureissi hands me a cup of warm water and some recently opened biscuits.

spans.text: Creak—the door opens. Centaureissi hands me a cup of warm water and some recently opened biscuits.

units.rawText: Commander, your multiple consecutive all-nighters have taken their toll on your body. Please take a break.
units.displayText: Commander, your multiple consecutive all-nighters have taken their toll on your body. Please take a break.

spans.text: Commander, your multiple consecutive all-nighters have taken their toll on your body. Please take a break.

units.rawText: Thank you for your concern, Centaureissi, but I'm fine. Oh yes, have Tony and Chris rested yet?
units.displayText: Thank you for your concern, Centaureissi, but I'm fine. Oh yes, have Tony and Chris rested yet?

spans.text: Thank you for your concern, Centaureissi, but I'm fine. Oh yes, have Tony and Chris rested yet?

units.rawText: I take the cup from her. Its warmth seems to alleviate my fatigue and after the sleepiness is gone, I continue staring at the radar monitoring screen.
units.displayText: I take the cup from her. Its warmth seems to alleviate my fatigue and after the sleepiness is gone, I continue staring at the radar monitoring screen.

spans.text: I take the cup from her. Its warmth seems to alleviate my fatigue and after the sleepiness is gone, I continue staring at the radar monitoring screen.

units.rawText: Yes. Chris just fell asleep and Tony is with him now.
units.displayText: Yes. Chris just fell asleep and Tony is with him now.

spans.text: Yes. Chris just fell asleep and Tony is with him now.

units.rawText: You should get some rest too, Commander. A string wound too tight will snap.
units.displayText: You should get some rest too, Commander. A string wound too tight will snap.

spans.text: You should get some rest too, Commander. A string wound too tight will snap.

units.rawText: Something just bugs me, though...
units.displayText: Something just bugs me, though...

spans.text: Something just bugs me, though...

units.rawText: I've checked our surroundings repeatedly as per your instructions. There are no enemy units nearby.
units.displayText: I've checked our surroundings repeatedly as per your instructions. There are no enemy units nearby.

spans.text: I've checked our surroundings repeatedly as per your instructions. There are no enemy units nearby.

units.rawText: (Sigh) Maybe I've been too on edge recently.
units.displayText: (Sigh) Maybe I've been too on edge recently.

spans.text: (Sigh) Maybe I've been too on edge recently.

units.rawText: I rub my temples and try to relax. Hopefully, all my worrying was for nothing.
units.displayText: I rub my temples and try to relax. Hopefully, all my worrying was for nothing.

spans.text: I rub my temples and try to relax. Hopefully, all my worrying was for nothing.

units.rawText: In that case, we should contact the defenders and report the current enemy movements to them. Any hesitation might mean danger.
units.displayText: In that case, we should contact the defenders and report the current enemy movements to them. Any hesitation might mean danger.

spans.text: In that case, we should contact the defenders and report the current enemy movements to them. Any hesitation might mean danger.

units.rawText: Understood.
units.displayText: Understood.

spans.text: Understood.

units.rawText: Once again, Centaureissi helps me contact the defending forces.
units.displayText: Once again, Centaureissi helps me contact the defending forces.

spans.text: Once again, Centaureissi helps me contact the defending forces.

units.rawText: This is Public Search Channel 8766, a lighthouse pointing the way home for lost exiles in times of war. Leave the information of the missing person and we will spread it over the channel for you. May you be reunited with your loved ones soon. Please leave your message after the beep.
units.displayText: This is Public Search Channel 8766, a lighthouse pointing the way home for lost exiles in times of war. Leave the information of the missing person and we will spread it over the channel for you. May you be reunited with your loved ones soon. Please leave your message after the beep.

units.rawText: The letters and wine for the soldiers must be packed separately, because the letters might not necessarily find their recipients, but the wine will.

units.displayText: Message received. Now transferring you to an assistant.

spans.text: Message received. Now transferring you to an assistant.

units.rawText: Order acknowledged by Messenger Pigeon 36...
units.displayText: Order acknowledged by Messenger Pigeon 36...

spans.text: Order acknowledged by Messenger Pigeon 36...

units.displayText: I push the radar receiver away to avoid electronic interference.

spans.text: I push the radar receiver away to avoid electronic interference.

units.rawText: Greetings, Commander. Are things going well on your end?
units.displayText: Greetings, Commander. Are things going well on your end?

spans.text: Greetings, Commander. Are things going well on your end?

units.rawText: We managed to infiltrate the enemy base and have returned to the safehouse.
units.displayText: We managed to infiltrate the enemy base and have returned to the safehouse.

spans.text: We managed to infiltrate the enemy base and have returned to the safehouse.

units.rawText: Our investigations revealed an unusual situation, which we need to report to HQ.
units.displayText: Our investigations revealed an unusual situation, which we need to report to HQ.

spans.text: Our investigations revealed an unusual situation, which we need to report to HQ.

units.rawText: Messenger Pigeon 36 copies. Beginning recording now.
units.displayText: Messenger Pigeon 36 copies. Beginning recording now.

spans.text: Messenger Pigeon 36 copies. Beginning recording now.

units.rawText: We discovered large quantities of shells and explosives in their armory.
units.displayText: We discovered large quantities of shells and explosives in their armory.

spans.text: We discovered large quantities of shells and explosives in their armory.

units.rawText: Recent enemy movements have been quite unusual. They are performing inspection and maintenance on their launchers and generally preparing them for operation.
units.displayText: Recent enemy movements have been quite unusual. They are performing inspection and maintenance on their launchers and generally preparing them for operation.

spans.text: Recent enemy movements have been quite unusual. They are performing inspection and maintenance on their launchers and generally preparing them for operation.

units.rawText: It is surmised that the enemy will conduct a large-scale missile strike on the city soon.
units.displayText: It is surmised that the enemy will conduct a large-scale missile strike on the city soon.

spans.text: It is surmised that the enemy will conduct a large-scale missile strike on the city soon.

units.rawText: Pigeon No. 36 is silent for a moment.
units.displayText: Pigeon No. 36 is silent for a moment.

spans.text: Pigeon No. 36 is silent for a moment.

units.rawText: ...That was quicker than expected. It seems the enemy's patience has reached its limits.
units.displayText: ...That was quicker than expected. It seems the enemy's patience has reached its limits.

spans.text: ...That was quicker than expected. It seems the enemy's patience has reached its limits.

units.rawText: Commander, HQ has news for you too.
units.displayText: Commander, HQ has news for you too.

spans.text: Commander, HQ has news for you too.

units.rawText: Recently, the stalemate in the neighboring city was broken. The neighboring forces intend to conduct a sweeping advance to capitalize on their victory, and once they wipe out the enemy, they will be able to redeploy part of their forces to support us.
units.displayText: Recently, the stalemate in the neighboring city was broken. The neighboring forces intend to conduct a sweeping advance to capitalize on their victory, and once they wipe out the enemy, they will be able to redeploy part of their forces to support us.

spans.text: Recently, the stalemate in the neighboring city was broken. The neighboring forces intend to conduct a sweeping advance to capitalize on their victory, and once they wipe out the enemy, they will be able to redeploy part of their forces to support us.

units.rawText: The increased tempo of enemy attacks on this city is largely due to the defeats they are suffering in the neighboring city. Right now, we need to preserve our forces and hold out until we can meet up with our reinforcements.
units.displayText: The increased tempo of enemy attacks on this city is largely due to the defeats they are suffering in the neighboring city. Right now, we need to preserve our forces and hold out until we can meet up with our reinforcements.

spans.text: The increased tempo of enemy attacks on this city is largely due to the defeats they are suffering in the neighboring city. Right now, we need to preserve our forces and hold out until we can meet up with our reinforcements.

units.rawText: There are still some civilians in the city which haven't been evacuated yet... Can we guarantee their safety?
units.displayText: There are still some civilians in the city which haven't been evacuated yet... Can we guarantee their safety?

spans.text: There are still some civilians in the city which haven't been evacuated yet... Can we guarantee their safety?

units.rawText: We'll inform the local forces to open Shelter No. 8 in the Western District. It has adequate food, water, and warm clothing, so providing for the civilians in the short term should not be a problem.
units.displayText: We'll inform the local forces to open Shelter No. 8 in the Western District. It has adequate food, water, and warm clothing, so providing for the civilians in the short term should not be a problem.

spans.text: We'll inform the local forces to open Shelter No. 8 in the Western District. It has adequate food, water, and warm clothing, so providing for the civilians in the short term should not be a problem.

units.rawText: Also, there are several guerilla squads based near the shelter, so they'll provide information about the shelter's surroundings. You don't have to worry about that.
units.displayText: Also, there are several guerilla squads based near the shelter, so they'll provide information about the shelter's surroundings. You don't have to worry about that.

spans.text: Also, there are several guerilla squads based near the shelter, so they'll provide information about the shelter's surroundings. You don't have to worry about that.

units.rawText: Yeah. Centaureissi and I will give all the support we can. In addition, there is one more thing I need to share...
units.displayText: Yeah. Centaureissi and I will give all the support we can. In addition, there is one more thing I need to share...

spans.text: Yeah. Centaureissi and I will give all the support we can. In addition, there is one more thing I need to share...

units.rawText: On our way out, we were not pursued by the enemy...
units.displayText: On our way out, we were not pursued by the enemy...

spans.text: On our way out, we were not pursued by the enemy...

units.rawText: Beepbeep—
units.displayText: Beepbeep—

spans.text: Beepbeep—

units.rawText: The radar receiver beeps loudly, indicating that something is wrong.
units.displayText: The radar receiver beeps loudly, indicating that something is wrong.

spans.text: The radar receiver beeps loudly, indicating that something is wrong.

units.rawText: Anomalous concentration of moving contacts detected, anomalous concentration of moving contacts detected...
units.displayText: Anomalous concentration of moving contacts detected, anomalous concentration of moving contacts detected...

spans.text: Anomalous concentration of moving contacts detected, anomalous concentration of moving contacts detected...

units.rawText: Crap!
units.displayText: Crap!

spans.text: Crap!

units.rawText: Is your situation... $^%&%*... Beep—
units.displayText: Is your situation... $^%&%*... Beep—

spans.text: Is your situation... $^%&%*... Beep—

units.rawText: The transmission suddenly cuts off!
units.displayText: The transmission suddenly cuts off!

spans.text: The transmission suddenly cuts off!

units.rawText: I'm picking up a spike in the number of enemy forces around the armory and the artillery emplacements! The enemy might be making a move soon! Centaureissi, figure out a way to contact defender intelligence!
units.displayText: I'm picking up a spike in the number of enemy forces around the armory and the artillery emplacements! The enemy might be making a move soon! Centaureissi, figure out a way to contact defender intelligence!

spans.text: I'm picking up a spike in the number of enemy forces around the armory and the artillery emplacements! The enemy might be making a move soon! Centaureissi, figure out a way to contact defender intelligence!

units.rawText: Centaureissi tries to adjust the frequency and restore communications multiple times as the shrill alarms go off, but her face is grim after repeated failures.
units.displayText: Centaureissi tries to adjust the frequency and restore communications multiple times as the shrill alarms go off, but her face is grim after repeated failures.

spans.text: Centaureissi tries to adjust the frequency and restore communications multiple times as the shrill alarms go off, but her face is grim after repeated failures.

units.rawText: It's no good. Even after changing frequencies I still can't connect.
units.displayText: It's no good. Even after changing frequencies I still can't connect.

spans.text: It's no good. Even after changing frequencies I still can't connect.

units.rawText: Commander, it seems Messenger Pigeon's signal... may have been intercepted.
units.displayText: Commander, it seems Messenger Pigeon's signal... may have been intercepted.

spans.text: Commander, it seems Messenger Pigeon's signal... may have been intercepted.

units.rawText: The disturbance awakens Tony, who hurries in from where he was resting next door.
units.displayText: The disturbance awakens Tony, who hurries in from where he was resting next door.

spans.text: The disturbance awakens Tony, who hurries in from where he was resting next door.

units.rawText: What's wrong, Commander?!
units.displayText: What's wrong, Commander?!

spans.text: What's wrong, Commander?!

units.rawText: <size=40>KABOOM!!!</size>
units.displayText: KABOOM!!!

spans.text: KABOOM!!!

units.rawText: An explosion thunders out from afar, shaking the entire wooden shack.
units.displayText: An explosion thunders out from afar, shaking the entire wooden shack.

spans.text: An explosion thunders out from afar, shaking the entire wooden shack.

units.rawText: My heart sinks. The radio signal detector shows people gathering around the artillery emplacements, and I can see coils of black smoke rising from the city through the gaps in the boarded-up windows.
units.displayText: My heart sinks. The radio signal detector shows people gathering around the artillery emplacements, and I can see coils of black smoke rising from the city through the gaps in the boarded-up windows.

spans.text: My heart sinks. The radio signal detector shows people gathering around the artillery emplacements, and I can see coils of black smoke rising from the city through the gaps in the boarded-up windows.

units.rawText: We miscalculated; their target isn't the inner city region, but...
units.displayText: We miscalculated; their target isn't the inner city region, but...

spans.text: We miscalculated; their target isn't the inner city region, but...

units.rawText: ...The defenders' intelligence center.
units.displayText: ...The defenders' intelligence center.

spans.text: ...The defenders' intelligence center.

units.rawText: The enemy found us. It wasn't that they didn't know what we were doing, but that they let us come back to bring in a bigger fish.
units.displayText: The enemy found us. It wasn't that they didn't know what we were doing, but that they let us come back to bring in a bigger fish.

spans.text: The enemy found us. It wasn't that they didn't know what we were doing, but that they let us come back to bring in a bigger fish.

units.rawText: They used us to pick up on the defenders' comm signal and lock onto the hidden intelligence center.
units.displayText: They used us to pick up on the defenders' comm signal and lock onto the hidden intelligence center.

spans.text: They used us to pick up on the defenders' comm signal and lock onto the hidden intelligence center.

units.rawText: This is bad...
units.displayText: This is bad...

spans.text: This is bad...

units.rawText: We need to find some way to contact Vayne; there are still a lot of defenders inside the city!
units.displayText: We need to find some way to contact Vayne; there are still a lot of defenders inside the city!

spans.text: We need to find some way to contact Vayne; there are still a lot of defenders inside the city!

units.rawText: It's too late for that now; we need to save ourselves first!
units.displayText: It's too late for that now; we need to save ourselves first!

spans.text: It's too late for that now; we need to save ourselves first!

units.rawText: Let's get Chris and figure out a way to escape!
units.displayText: Let's get Chris and figure out a way to escape!

spans.text: Let's get Chris and figure out a way to escape!

units.rawText: <size=40>BOOM!</size>
units.displayText: BOOM!

spans.text: BOOM!

units.rawText: The next explosion hits much closer to our little safehouse and the violent impact nearly knocks me off my feet. Centaureissi hurries over to help me up, but I shout at her instead.
units.displayText: The next explosion hits much closer to our little safehouse and the violent impact nearly knocks me off my feet. Centaureissi hurries over to help me up, but I shout at her instead.

spans.text: The next explosion hits much closer to our little safehouse and the violent impact nearly knocks me off my feet. Centaureissi hurries over to help me up, but I shout at her instead.

units.rawText: <size=40>GO NOW!</size>
units.displayText: GO NOW!

spans.text: GO NOW!

units.rawText: The blonde girl bites her lip before picking up her rifle and dragging me outside. Tony turns around and emerges from the bedroom with a confused Chris in tow.
units.displayText: The blonde girl bites her lip before picking up her rifle and dragging me outside. Tony turns around and emerges from the bedroom with a confused Chris in tow.

spans.text: The blonde girl bites her lip before picking up her rifle and dragging me outside. Tony turns around and emerges from the bedroom with a confused Chris in tow.

units.rawText: After we rush out of the safehouse, we look back. The flames from the city claw at the heavens as thick plumes of smoke reach into the sky... However, we don't have the time to worry about all this, because in the next moment—
units.displayText: After we rush out of the safehouse, we look back. The flames from the city claw at the heavens as thick plumes of smoke reach into the sky... However, we don't have the time to worry about all this, because in the next moment—

spans.text: After we rush out of the safehouse, we look back. The flames from the city claw at the heavens as thick plumes of smoke reach into the sky... However, we don't have the time to worry about all this, because in the next moment—

units.rawText: <size=40>KABOOM!!!!</size>
units.displayText: KABOOM!!!!

spans.text: KABOOM!!!!

units.rawText: The sound of an explosion rings in my ear, and I reflexively move to shield Chris and Centaureissi with my body. Before I can reach them, the powerful shockwave sends me sprawling to the ground.
units.displayText: The sound of an explosion rings in my ear, and I reflexively move to shield Chris and Centaureissi with my body. Before I can reach them, the powerful shockwave sends me sprawling to the ground.

spans.text: The sound of an explosion rings in my ear, and I reflexively move to shield Chris and Centaureissi with my body. Before I can reach them, the powerful shockwave sends me sprawling to the ground.

units.rawText: Ugh!
units.displayText: Ugh!

spans.text: Ugh!

units.rawText: My head hits the ground hard and I almost pass out from the pain as blood blurs my vision.
units.displayText: My head hits the ground hard and I almost pass out from the pain as blood blurs my vision.

spans.text: My head hits the ground hard and I almost pass out from the pain as blood blurs my vision.

units.rawText: In the distance, I can vaguely make out armed soldiers rushing towards us... However, my condition is so bad that all I can make out is a vague blur.
units.displayText: In the distance, I can vaguely make out armed soldiers rushing towards us... However, my condition is so bad that all I can make out is a vague blur.

spans.text: In the distance, I can vaguely make out armed soldiers rushing towards us... However, my condition is so bad that all I can make out is a vague blur.

units.rawText: <size=40>Commander!!!</size>
units.displayText: Commander!!!

spans.text: Commander!!!

units.rawText: Get... Get to cover!
units.displayText: Get... Get to cover!

spans.text: Get... Get to cover!

units.rawText: I ignore my body's discomfort and haul everyone over to the nearby ditch, hunkering down and watching every move our unwelcome guests make.
units.displayText: I ignore my body's discomfort and haul everyone over to the nearby ditch, hunkering down and watching every move our unwelcome guests make.

spans.text: I ignore my body's discomfort and haul everyone over to the nearby ditch, hunkering down and watching every move our unwelcome guests make.

units.rawText: Is this the place?
units.displayText: Is this the place?

spans.text: Is this the place?

units.rawText: Yeah, this is it! The signal from the intelligence center came from here.
units.displayText: Yeah, this is it! The signal from the intelligence center came from here.

spans.text: Yeah, this is it! The signal from the intelligence center came from here.

units.rawText: Man, just look at that crater... if there was anyone here, they'd probably been blown to bits.
units.displayText: Man, just look at that crater... if there was anyone here, they'd probably been blown to bits.

spans.text: Man, just look at that crater... if there was anyone here, they'd probably been blown to bits.

units.rawText: That might not be the case. Remember that we're dealing with that "Commander" here.
units.displayText: That might not be the case. Remember that we're dealing with that "Commander" here.

spans.text: That might not be the case. Remember that we're dealing with that "Commander" here.

units.rawText: You know about them, right? They were supposedly dead, but then they showed up on the battlefield again and snuck into the base like a ghost...
units.displayText: You know about them, right? They were supposedly dead, but then they showed up on the battlefield again and snuck into the base like a ghost...

spans.text: You know about them, right? They were supposedly dead, but then they showed up on the battlefield again and snuck into the base like a ghost...

units.rawText: The safehouse is in ruins, and the fire left behind by the explosion is still burning. Capture squad troopers search the wreckage in pairs and trios to find any survivors.
units.displayText: The safehouse is in ruins, and the fire left behind by the explosion is still burning. Capture squad troopers search the wreckage in pairs and trios to find any survivors.

spans.text: The safehouse is in ruins, and the fire left behind by the explosion is still burning. Capture squad troopers search the wreckage in pairs and trios to find any survivors.

units.rawText: Why now, of all times...
units.displayText: Why now, of all times...

spans.text: Why now, of all times...

units.rawText: This was clearly a planned attack. After our plan to rescue Chris was leaked, the enemy somehow learned we would contact the defenders from this safehouse.
units.displayText: This was clearly a planned attack. After our plan to rescue Chris was leaked, the enemy somehow learned we would contact the defenders from this safehouse.

spans.text: This was clearly a planned attack. After our plan to rescue Chris was leaked, the enemy somehow learned we would contact the defenders from this safehouse.

units.rawText: After that, they had people intercept the intel center's signal and used it to triangulate the intel center's exact location.
units.displayText: After that, they had people intercept the intel center's signal and used it to triangulate the intel center's exact location.

spans.text: After that, they had people intercept the intel center's signal and used it to triangulate the intel center's exact location.

units.rawText: But the mini-radar said everything was fine. We shouldn't have been spotted by the enemy... So how did the information get out?
units.displayText: But the mini-radar said everything was fine. We shouldn't have been spotted by the enemy... So how did the information get out?

spans.text: But the mini-radar said everything was fine. We shouldn't have been spotted by the enemy... So how did the information get out?

units.rawText: No way...
units.displayText: No way...

spans.text: No way...

units.rawText: Tony recalls scattered scenes from his struggle in the interrogation room. Apparently, something had been taken from him when he was grappling with the interrogator.
units.displayText: Tony recalls scattered scenes from his struggle in the interrogation room. Apparently, something had been taken from him when he was grappling with the interrogator.

spans.text: Tony recalls scattered scenes from his struggle in the interrogation room. Apparently, something had been taken from him when he was grappling with the interrogator.

units.rawText: The cold wind blows, and his hands tremble. He finally realizes what went wrong.
units.displayText: The cold wind blows, and his hands tremble. He finally realizes what went wrong.

spans.text: The cold wind blows, and his hands tremble. He finally realizes what went wrong.

units.rawText: Oh no! The communicator you gave me is gone!
units.displayText: Oh no! The communicator you gave me is gone!

spans.text: Oh no! The communicator you gave me is gone!

units.rawText: I... I lost it! It was in the interrogation room...
units.displayText: I... I lost it! It was in the interrogation room...

spans.text: I... I lost it! It was in the interrogation room...

units.rawText: ...Did you lose it during that fight back then?
units.displayText: ...Did you lose it during that fight back then?

spans.text: ...Did you lose it during that fight back then?

units.rawText: I close my eyes and sigh.
units.displayText: I close my eyes and sigh.

spans.text: I close my eyes and sigh.

units.rawText: Well, there's no point blaming each other now. We need to deal with the problem at hand.
units.displayText: Well, there's no point blaming each other now. We need to deal with the problem at hand.

spans.text: Well, there's no point blaming each other now. We need to deal with the problem at hand.

units.rawText: It's my fault... I did this to everyone...
units.displayText: It's my fault... I did this to everyone...

spans.text: It's my fault... I did this to everyone...

units.rawText: Tony trembles uncontrollably as regret floods his neural cloud. Chris pulls on his sleeve to try and snap him out of it.
units.displayText: Tony trembles uncontrollably as regret floods his neural cloud. Chris pulls on his sleeve to try and snap him out of it.

spans.text: Tony trembles uncontrollably as regret floods his neural cloud. Chris pulls on his sleeve to try and snap him out of it.

units.rawText: The pink-haired Doll looks down at the dirty hands tugging on him and he is filled with mixed feelings.
units.displayText: The pink-haired Doll looks down at the dirty hands tugging on him and he is filled with mixed feelings.

spans.text: The pink-haired Doll looks down at the dirty hands tugging on him and he is filled with mixed feelings.

units.rawText: Before he can ponder the matter further, the members of the capture squad in the distance soon sense the disturbance over here and take our position with gunfire.
units.displayText: Before he can ponder the matter further, the members of the capture squad in the distance soon sense the disturbance over here and take our position with gunfire.

spans.text: Before he can ponder the matter further, the members of the capture squad in the distance soon sense the disturbance over here and take our position with gunfire.

units.rawText: I see bloodstains... They're headed that way!!! Over there!!!
units.displayText: I see bloodstains... They're headed that way!!! Over there!!!

spans.text: I see bloodstains... They're headed that way!!! Over there!!!

units.rawText: In the ditch!!! They're in the ditch!!!
units.displayText: In the ditch!!! They're in the ditch!!!

spans.text: In the ditch!!! They're in the ditch!!!

units.rawText: Dakkadakkadakka...
units.displayText: Dakkadakkadakka...

spans.text: Dakkadakkadakka...

units.rawText: Bullets rain down on the ditch and the heavy suppressive fire leaves us completely unable to move. Meanwhile, the enemy is drawing closer and closer...
units.displayText: Bullets rain down on the ditch and the heavy suppressive fire leaves us completely unable to move. Meanwhile, the enemy is drawing closer and closer...

spans.text: Bullets rain down on the ditch and the heavy suppressive fire leaves us completely unable to move. Meanwhile, the enemy is drawing closer and closer...

units.rawText: This is bad, Commander, we can't escape...
units.displayText: This is bad, Commander, we can't escape...

spans.text: This is bad, Commander, we can't escape...

units.rawText: You, Chris, and Tony should run together. Take this.
units.displayText: You, Chris, and Tony should run together. Take this.

spans.text: You, Chris, and Tony should run together. Take this.

units.rawText: Centaureissi takes off her optical camouflage module and hands it to me. Her face is grim and determined.
units.displayText: Centaureissi takes off her optical camouflage module and hands it to me. Her face is grim and determined.

spans.text: Centaureissi takes off her optical camouflage module and hands it to me. Her face is grim and determined.

units.rawText: While I don't know how many of them I can take out, I'll stay behind to cover your escape and buy you time to retreat.
units.displayText: While I don't know how many of them I can take out, I'll stay behind to cover your escape and buy you time to retreat.

spans.text: While I don't know how many of them I can take out, I'll stay behind to cover your escape and buy you time to retreat.

units.rawText: Centaureissi!
units.displayText: Centaureissi!

spans.text: Centaureissi!

units.rawText: Don't worry, Commander. I'll catch up with you after I deal with them.
units.displayText: Don't worry, Commander. I'll catch up with you after I deal with them.

spans.text: Don't worry, Commander. I'll catch up with you after I deal with them.

units.rawText: But if you stay behind, you'll die!
units.displayText: But if you stay behind, you'll die!

spans.text: But if you stay behind, you'll die!

units.rawText: It's alright. Even if they try to force their way into my neural cloud to mine it of information, I'll make sure I format myself before I crash.
units.displayText: It's alright. Even if they try to force their way into my neural cloud to mine it of information, I'll make sure I format myself before I crash.

spans.text: It's alright. Even if they try to force their way into my neural cloud to mine it of information, I'll make sure I format myself before I crash.

units.rawText: As long as Commander survives, we have a chance of winning this and this city will have a future.
units.displayText: As long as Commander survives, we have a chance of winning this and this city will have a future.

spans.text: As long as Commander survives, we have a chance of winning this and this city will have a future.

units.rawText: You...
units.displayText: You...

spans.text: You...

units.rawText: Centaureissi ignores Tony's words. Her expression is resolute.
units.displayText: Centaureissi ignores Tony's words. Her expression is resolute.

spans.text: Centaureissi ignores Tony's words. Her expression is resolute.

units.rawText: The way ahead is difficult, but I believe the Commander can guide you through it. I will be praying for you.
units.displayText: The way ahead is difficult, but I believe the Commander can guide you through it. I will be praying for you.

spans.text: The way ahead is difficult, but I believe the Commander can guide you through it. I will be praying for you.

units.rawText: She turns to me and executes a crisp salute.
units.displayText: She turns to me and executes a crisp salute.

spans.text: She turns to me and executes a crisp salute.

units.rawText: Please take care, Commander.
units.displayText: Please take care, Commander.

spans.text: Please take care, Commander.

units.rawText: Centaureissi has chosen for me, and given the circumstances, her decision is the right one.
units.displayText: Centaureissi has chosen for me, and given the circumstances, her decision is the right one.

spans.text: Centaureissi has chosen for me, and given the circumstances, her decision is the right one.

units.rawText: By doing so, she will save the most lives with the least sacrifice. The cruel calculus of warfare does not allow for the uncertainty and irrationality of emotions, only the simple arithmetic of loss versus gain.
units.displayText: By doing so, she will save the most lives with the least sacrifice. The cruel calculus of warfare does not allow for the uncertainty and irrationality of emotions, only the simple arithmetic of loss versus gain.

spans.text: By doing so, she will save the most lives with the least sacrifice. The cruel calculus of warfare does not allow for the uncertainty and irrationality of emotions, only the simple arithmetic of loss versus gain.

units.rawText: Although resentment churns in my heart, although my eyes burn, I grit my teeth and take the camouflage module from her.
units.displayText: Although resentment churns in my heart, although my eyes burn, I grit my teeth and take the camouflage module from her.

spans.text: Although resentment churns in my heart, although my eyes burn, I grit my teeth and take the camouflage module from her.

units.rawText: You take care too.
units.displayText: You take care too.

spans.text: You take care too.

units.rawText: Centaureissi takes up her battle-scarred G36, rushes out of the ditch and plunges headlong into the enemy.
units.displayText: Centaureissi takes up her battle-scarred G36, rushes out of the ditch and plunges headlong into the enemy.

spans.text: Centaureissi takes up her battle-scarred G36, rushes out of the ditch and plunges headlong into the enemy.

units.rawText: RUN!!
units.displayText: RUN!!

spans.text: RUN!!

units.rawText: I grab Chris and activate the camouflage, running through the smoky ruins as Tony trails behind me.
units.displayText: I grab Chris and activate the camouflage, running through the smoky ruins as Tony trails behind me.

spans.text: I grab Chris and activate the camouflage, running through the smoky ruins as Tony trails behind me.

units.rawText: As we put the ruins of the safehouse behind us, the sounds of gunfire gradually fade from our ears.

units.displayText: Centaureissi...

spans.text: Centaureissi...
